summary: By the spectral theorem for the Hecke operators at the places split off level (IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors) — right translation is unitary for the Petersson product, so the adjoint of T_{w,j} is T_{w̄,j} and the operators form a commuting family closed under adjoints (a normal family; the Hecke operators themselves need not be unitary) — the principal forms are spanned by joint eigenvectors; each lies in the p-part for its system of eigenvalues.

steps.claim: The p-parts are subspaces of principalForms(D, V), itself a subspace of the forms on V; by the order isomorphism between subspaces of principalForms(D, V) and subspaces of the forms below it (mapIic), it suffices that principalForms(D, V) is contained in the image of the sum of the p-parts.
steps.lean:
(_root_.map_eq_top_iff (mapIic _)).1
  (top_unique ((IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors (B := innerₛₗ ℂ) ⟨by simp_all,
  V.inner_formRep⟩ (p := D.IsSplitOffLevel) (by grind [IsSplitOffLevel, star_star]) (fun _ h ↦
  levelSpace_anti (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf h.2)) fun w h j ↦ by simpa [heckeOperator, h] using
  ((D.heckeOperator (w, j)).1 V · |>.2)).trans (span_le.2 fun z ⟨h, c, a⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨z, h⟩, mem_iSup_of_mem
  (∑ᶠ h, c ⟨⟨·, h⟩, ·⟩).uncurry (by aesop (add simp [eigenPart, heckeOperator])), rfl⟩)))

steps.claim: principalForms(D, V) is spanned by joint eigenvectors of all T_{w,j}, w split off level (spectral theorem IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors): right translation is unitary for the Petersson product (Space.inner_formRep), the set of places split off level is closed under conjugation, the principal forms are spherical at these places (levelSpace_anti, maxCompactAt_le_levelOf), and they are stable under T_{w,j} (the values of D.heckeOperator (w, j)).
steps.lean:
((IsUnitary.le_span_hecke_eigenvectors (B := innerₛₗ ℂ) ⟨by simp_all,
  V.inner_formRep⟩ (p := D.IsSplitOffLevel) (by grind [IsSplitOffLevel, star_star]) (fun _ h ↦
  levelSpace_anti (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf h.2)) fun w h j ↦ by simpa [heckeOperator, h] using
  ((D.heckeOperator (w, j)).1 V · |>.2)).trans

steps.claim: Each joint eigenvector z, T_{w,j} z = c(w, j) z for the places split off level, lies in the p-part for the system p(w, j) = c(w, j) if w is split off level and p(w, j) = 0 otherwise (heckeOperator (w, j) = 0 there); hence the span lies in the sum of the p-parts.
steps.lean:
(span_le.2 fun z ⟨h, c, a⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨z, h⟩, mem_iSup_of_mem
  (∑ᶠ h, c ⟨⟨·, h⟩, ·⟩).uncurry (by aesop (add simp [eigenPart, heckeOperator])), rfl⟩)))
